g:HTMLPanel.p: Navigation lists: Nav, NavTabs, NavPills and NavUnderline, with an AnchorListItem per link.

d:Example.heading: Basic
d:Example.description: Mark the current link `active`; `enabled="false"` disables a link.

d:Example.heading: Tabs, pills and underline
d:Example.description: The same links, styled by the container. For tabs that switch content, see Tabs.

d:Example.heading: Fill, justified and vertical
d:Example.description: `fill` stretches the links over the width, `justified` makes them equal width, and `vertical` stacks them.

d:Example.heading: With a dropdown
d:Example.description: A `ListDropDown` puts a dropdown menu in a nav; its toggle is an `AnchorButton`.
